chains.title: CREB3L4 binds the ref allele at an unannotated element and modulates PELI2

links.claim: CREB3L4 binds the ref C allele more strongly than the alt T allele. QBiC-SELEX gives CREB3L4 its own model with effect -1.314 and a CIS-BP-mapped CREB3L2 model with effect -2.335; both are ref-higher and above the gate. No ENCODE ChIP-seq peak contains this variant in any biosample, so occupancy is unknown. CREB3L4 is preferred over CREB3L2 because CREB3L4 has its own QBiC-SELEX model and is much more highly expressed in MCF7.
The variant lies in a non-coding, non-annotated region with no overlapping cCRE; the nearest dELS is 1868 bp away, so any CREB3L4 response element here would be unannotated.

PELI2 is the nearest protein-coding gene at 230.8 kb upstream, but GTEx v8 reports no significant eQTL for this variant in any tissue and no breast-tissue eQTL; Open Targets lists only a weak molecular QTL (PIP 0.03) for ENSG00000259868, not PELI2. The variant-to-PELI2 link is therefore indirect.
MCF7 cells express CREB3L4 at 48.8 TPM, but no MCF-7 ChIP-seq peak is reported at this site, so expression is present while occupancy in the stated cell type is not established.

Altered PELI2 expression could plausibly affect breast-cancer biology because PELI2 is a Pellino E3 ubiquitin ligase with cancer-prognostic literature, but no breast-cancer-specific evidence links this variant to PELI2 or phenotype.

predictions: Allele-specific CREB3L4 ChIP/CUT&RUN in MCF7 should show stronger ref C than alt T occupancy at this base if the QBiC-SELEX prediction is realized in cells.
An MCF7 reporter carrying the ref vs alt sequence should show ref-higher activity that is reduced by CREB3L4 knockdown.
If CREB3L4 activates PELI2, the alt allele should lower PELI2 expression; if CREB3L4 represses PELI2, the alt allele should increase it.
falsified_if: CREB3L4 shows no allele-specific binding at this base in a direct assay.
CREB3L4 occupancy is absent at this site in MCF7 and PELI2 expression is not allele-linked.
The QBiC-SELEX signal is reproduced only by another bZIP factor and not by CREB3L4 itself.

chains.title: TGIF1 binds the ref allele at an unannotated element and represses PELI2

links.claim: TGIF1 binds the ref C allele more strongly than the alt T allele. QBiC-SELEX reports effect -2.43 (ref higher, above gate) using a CIS-BP-mapped TGIF2 model; no ENCODE TGIF1 ChIP-seq peak contains the variant in MCF-7, and no ENCODE TF peak contains it in any biosample, so occupancy is unknown.
The variant is in a non-coding region with no overlapping cCRE; the nearest annotated dELS is 1868 bp away, so this would be an unannotated regulatory element.

PELI2 is the nearest protein-coding gene at 230.8 kb upstream, but GTEx v8 reports no significant eQTL and no breast-tissue eQTL for this variant; Open Targets' weak molecular QTL is for ENSG00000259868, not PELI2.
TGIF1 is expressed in MCF7 at 39.86 TPM, but no MCF-7 TGIF1 ChIP-seq peak is reported here; absence can also mean no TGIF1 experiment in that biosample.

Because TGIF1 is a transcriptional repressor, loss of TGIF1 binding on the alt allele could de-repress PELI2 and contribute to breast-cancer biology; this is speculative and relies on generic Pellino/PELI2 cancer literature.

predictions: Allele-specific TGIF1 ChIP/CUT&RUN should show stronger ref C than alt T binding at this site if TGIF1 occupies it in MCF7.
If TGIF1 represses PELI2, the alt allele should increase PELI2 expression in MCF7 cells.
The allele-specific effect should be reduced when TGIF1 is knocked down.
falsified_if: TGIF1 does not occupy this site or shows no allele-specific binding in a direct assay.
The alt allele does not change PELI2 expression in a TGIF1-dependent manner.
The shared TGIF2/MEIS3 model signal is shown to be driven by another factor.

chains.title: CREB3L2 binds the ref allele at an unannotated element

links.claim: CREB3L2 binds the ref C allele more strongly than the alt T allele. QBiC-SELEX reports effect -2.258 with z -60.99 (ref higher) using a CIS-BP-mapped CREB3L1 model; no ENCODE ChIP-seq peak contains this variant, so occupancy is unknown and this is in vitro binding evidence only.
The variant is not in an annotated cCRE and the nearest dELS is 1868 bp away, so any CREB3L2 element would be unannotated.

PELI2 is the nearest protein-coding gene, 230.8 kb upstream, but direct evidence that this variant regulates PELI2 is absent; GTEx reports no significant eQTL and no breast-tissue eQTL, and Open Targets' weak molecular QTL is not for PELI2.
CREB3L2 is expressed in MCF7 at only 7.06 TPM, and no MCF-7 ChIP-seq peak is reported at this site; the cell-type link is expression-only.
If CREB3L2 regulates PELI2, altered PELI2 dosage could affect breast-cancer biology through Pellino E3 ligase function, but this link is unproven and supported only by generic cancer literature.

predictions: Allele-specific CREB3L2 ChIP/CUT&RUN should show stronger ref C than alt T binding at this base if CREB3L2 occupies it in MCF7.
The effect should be weaker in MCF7 than for CREB3L4 because CREB3L2 is expressed at lower levels.
If CREB3L2 activates PELI2, the alt allele should lower PELI2 expression.
falsified_if: CREB3L2 does not bind this site in a direct assay despite the QBiC-SELEX prediction.
The QBiC-SELEX signal is not reproduced for CREB3L2 itself and instead reflects a related bZIP factor.
No allele-specific PELI2 expression change is observed.
